description:
Find an unknown object, property, value, or type within the narrowest known asset-qualified Property Tree path. Results include match evidence and paths usable unchanged with unity_yaml_read before editing.

Connected searches use the live Editor graph, including unsaved changes and all array indices; unavailable live targets fall back to disk YAML. Compound roots include subassets. Shared/cyclic references use their first canonical path; path matches keep the shallowest matching node per branch.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring. Prefix with `re:` for a case-insensitive regular expression.

match_fields.description: Optional comma-separated scope: path, field_name, field_value, type, or all. Defaults to all.

limit.description: Maximum number of retained result nodes after shallow path de-duplication. Each field or type node remains an individual result.
